cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.

mechanism: A uses its former cake-judging pupil introduction habits to demand an apology for prejudicing comparison, rejecting encouragement as a defense.
confusable: Not asking B to say the cake was best: A wants the biased framing acknowledged before flavor was judged.
comparison: Unequal starting location versus unequal verbal framing.
seedUse: D195 cake named/interesting attempt/flavor/encouragement; S05 taught neutral introductions.
